entities.name: Cathédrale du Sacré-Coeur, Port Vila
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Cathédrale du Sacré-Cœur is a modern Catholic cathedral in Port Vila, Vanuatu. It is the seat of the Diocese of Port-Vila. The church is dedicated to the sacred Heart of Jesus.
